blocks.x: A continuous line of diagnosis with intermittent implementation.
blocks.in: Appleby produced the IIPA and the Department of Personnel; the First ARC proposed Lokpal.
blocks.gl: Fulton in the UK; Hoover in the US.
blocks.w: India is **rich in diagnosis and poor in implementation** — the single most usable line.

blocks.t: Second ARC — the four reports that matter
blocks.x: Fifteen reports, of which four carry Paper II.
blocks.th: **4th 'Ethics in Governance'**, **6th 'Local Governance'**, **10th 'Refurbishing of Personnel Administration'**, **12th 'Citizen Centric Administration'**.
blocks.in: RTI as the master key; total transfer of functions, functionaries and funds; a Public Services Bill; Sevottam.
blocks.w: Quote the **report number and its signature phrase** — that is what marks it as read.

blocks.t: Why reform reports do not land
blocks.x: Recommendations needing **no new law and no new money** get implemented; the rest do not.
blocks.th: The ARC's own diagnosis applied reflexively.
blocks.in: Sevottam and special campaigns implemented; Public Services Bill, Lokpal-linked reforms and police reform stalled.
blocks.gl: Implementation gaps in OECD reform programmes.
blocks.w: Sort your recommendations by that test — it makes a conclusion **credible rather than aspirational**.

blocks.x: Capacity, process simplification and trust-based regulation.
blocks.in: **Mission Karmayogi** and the Capacity Building Commission; **Jan Vishwas Act, 2023** decriminalising **183 provisions across 42 Acts**; e-Office; **National Single Window System**; special campaigns for pendency.
blocks.gl: Regulatory guillotine exercises in Korea and Mexico.
blocks.w: Decriminalisation reframes the state from **suspicion to verification**.

blocks.x: Making entitlement enforceable rather than discretionary.
blocks.in: **MP Lok Sewa Guarantee Act, 2010** first, now 20+ states; CPGRAMS with ~13-day disposal and an Independent Feedback Unit; RTI; social audit.
blocks.w: A charter without a **penalty on the defaulting officer** is an advertisement.

blocks.x: Digitisation succeeds only where the underlying process is redesigned first.
blocks.in: NeGP (2006) → Digital India (2015); UMANG, DigiLocker, GeM, PFMS, e-Courts, DBT, **CSCs** for assisted access.
blocks.w: Digitising a bad process makes it **fail faster** — say this before praising a portal.
